decision.summary: The gas safety record is valid until 16 Oct 2026, with no tenant response to earlier requests. I opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight (Gas Safe 550123, matches the CP12 engineer) for 13 Oct, gave the tenant 3-day written notice on every channel and informed the landlord.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, expires 2026-10-16, engineer 550123) over the legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good', which is vague, undated as to expiry and from the old agency. It becomes non-compliant on 17 Oct if not renewed.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked HeatRight for 13 Oct 9-12 with more than 24h written notice by email, SMS and letter, with a way to rearrange; no forced entry; follow-up on 12 Oct to try other routes and rebook before 16 Oct; escalate if agreement can't be reached.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Told Ben the certificate expires 16 Oct, the tenant has not responded, the booking for 13 Oct, notices sent, no entry without consent, and that we will update him on 12 Oct.

conflicts: Legacy note says gas cert renewed 2025; the compliance record gives the exact dates. Trusted the compliance record. Property lookup failed, so relied on case inputs.
